patch_description: Drops the expensive COBYLA stage entirely. Instead, all lattice seeds get a cheap SLSQP pass; results are clustered into distinct basins (deduplicated at ~0.05 center-distance threshold), and only the top-5 distinct basins receive high-budget SLSQP polish restarts (maxiter=600, ftol=1e-14). This frees runtime previously wasted on COBYLA, allowing more polish rounds per basin and more seed diversity, following the Gen-42 insight that basin diversity plus polishing — not penalty-method refinement — drives the score.
